name: PromoSplit
description: Two-column promotional block: image on one side, copy on the other. Use for campaign landing pages and mid-page conversion moments.

fields.name: Eyebrow
fields.guidance: Small label above the heading. All caps in the design.

fields.name: Heading
fields.guidance: Two-line clamp on mobile — keep it tight.

fields.name: Body
fields.guidance: Body copy. Inline links fine, no headings.

fields.name: Image
fields.guidance: 16:9. Alt text required for AA compliance.

fields.name: SecondaryCta
fields.guidance: Omit unless there's a genuine secondary action.
